pages.text: A $(thing)mathemagician$() is a field researcher who makes a relation usable. They observe, choose assumptions, compose runes, and test the result against the world.$(br2)A failed experiment is not a curse. It is a note that a premise was missing, a boundary was wrong, or the construction asked for more than the available materials can witness.

pages.title: Portable Notes
pages.text: A programmed talisman is a portable notebook that holds one inscribed demonstration. The Talisman tab inspects the proof bound to the item in hand; the Laboratory tests a construction; Theorems preserve demonstrations that have survived repeated use.
